MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The weather-resistant duct tape felt useful alongside my outdoor deck screws because it could help with outdoor repairs where exposure to weather matters.",
    "That tape matched the practical repair purpose behind my recent purchases, with a pack size I would actually choose."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Hose clamps, epoxy and super glue involve fastening or repair, but they do not serve the wood and drywall work reflected in my recent nails, screws and anchors.",
    "Steel wool and polishing compounds assume surface-finishing work I have not shown a need for, and painter's tape assumes a painting job.",
    "My vacuum bags were a specific replacement supply, not a reason to buy spray bottles or a gallon of degreaser.",
    "Ten tubes of glue and an assortment of decorating hooks feel unnecessary when I am choosing supplies for particular tasks."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The suggestions treated general repair supplies as interchangeable, even though the material and job determine what I need.",
    "One vacuum-bag purchase seemed to suggest a broader cleaning need than I actually expressed.",
    "Buying large packs of nails and screws does not mean I want large quantities of every household supply."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated purchases of framing nails, wood screws and drywall anchors point most clearly toward construction and mounting tasks.",
    "Details such as nail angle, screw dimensions and outdoor rust resistance matter because supplies need to fit the intended use.",
    "An adjacent product needs a clear immediate purpose; being useful around the house is not enough for me to choose it."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions recognized my practical repair interests but stretched them into cleaning, polishing and decorating needs that my recent purchases do not establish."
}
